'''The Long Run''' was the starting leg of the [[Dragonbane circuit]]. It was a smooth straightway over marsh grass. Because it was clear of obstacles, it was easy for [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racers]] to accelerate to high speed. This was also the dangerous part of The Long Run: racers could reach such high speeds that even slight mistakes could result in fatal crashes.
